data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 makes verification independent iff the checker finds a latent contradiction the author missed, quantified by Corrective Pivot Points (non-trivial author rewrites). This is both over- and under-inclusive relative to the problem. It is under-inclusive for confirming execution: an independent checker that re-executes and confirms a counting/execution claim forces zero author changes and has zero pivot points, so by iff it is not independently verified. It is over-inclusive because a same-engine checker can force an author rewrite via a hallucinated error (the target's own False-Positive Loop countercondition), yielding a positive CPP score despite being non-independent. Thus CPP neither tracks nor evidences the problem's notion of independent verification.
